answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the haven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The prism explorer publishes the whole merge tree. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. A 193 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
